title: 1983 Fleer #278 Gary Carter Expos
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1983 Fleer #278 Gary Carter Expos sports trading card is a must-have for any baseball fan. Featuring the iconic Montreal Expos player, this card is a great addition to any collection. The card is from the Major League Baseball (MLB) league and is part of the 1983 Fleer set.

This card is a base set card and is not autographed. It is perfect for collectors who are looking for a specific type of card. The card number is 278 and it is from the 1983 season. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this piece of baseball history.
